Auto trace through variable macro

Macros ›› Different types of macros ››

This macro is created via icon of the displays expandable toolbar (fourth from the bottom).


When activated, this macro leaves on the figure the trace of a list of objects when a variable takes values from it's mini to maxi values.

To be noticed : The trace is not permanent and will disappear with tool .
